verdict.rationale: Mirrors' unit of automation is the correction: context routed into an agent when its conditions match. Before activation, you can review corrections by previewing their routing conditions against stored traces to see matches, misses, and unexpected matches. After activation, the docs say teams can keep, revise, or roll back a change, managed per correction in one central place. There is no evidence of explicit version history, diffs, or a rollback mechanism beyond marketing statements. missing for 10: explicit versioning/change history for corrections, documented rollback mechanics (how a rollback is performed, restore points), independent or hands-on corroboration.
